text:
Maya: We keep seeing PM action items drift. Can we agree a short follow-up ritual so ownership and dates are obvious?
Sam: +1. My proposal: 48h triage note, 14-day remediation sync, 90-day recurrence review.
Priya: Make the 14-day a 30-min calendar invite the incident owner creates within 72h of closure and add eng-oncall + SRE.
Kevin: SLA idea by severity: Critical = 7d, Major = 30d, Minor = 90d. Owners can request extensions with a short justification.
Elena: Add a single POC field in the postmortem and a top-of-doc tracker table listing open remediations.
Nate: I can wire IncidentBot to post reminders and a weekly digest for remediations older than 14 days.
Maya: Quick 14-day template:
```
14-day check:
- POC: <name>
- Open remediations (links)
- Severity + SLA
- Status: on-track / blocked / deferred
- Next actions + owners + due dates
```
Sam: Use ticket tags incident-<id>-rem and rem-owner:<github> so board filters can show open remediations.
Priya: IC rotation: monthly nominations, maintain a simple roster doc, and require a 15-min handoff note in the thread when rotating.
Kevin: Escalation rule: if a 14-day check is missed twice, escalate to the team lead and flag on the digest.
IncidentBot: Reminder scheduled: "2050001234 - 14-day follow-up" assigned to Maya in 14 days.
Maya: I'll draft the templates and the rotation one-pager, then ping for quick review. :rocket:
